visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens inside an airplane cabin where a toddler boy with short dark hair and bangs is seated. He is wearing large red-and-black over-ear headphones and a denim pinafore over a white t-shirt. A white cooling ring is around his neck. He looks focused as he adjusts the headphones with both hands. (2) The scene cuts to a large wooden torii gate at Meiji Jingu Shrine. People in summer clothing are walking through the wide entrance. The boy is shown walking on the asphalt path and then onto a gravel area, looking curious and occasionally smiling. (3) The boy and an older toddler girl with pigtails are playing hide-and-seek behind large wooden pillars of the shrine buildings. They peek out with bright smiles and giggle. The background shows traditional Japanese architecture and lush green trees. (4) The children are seen looking up at a massive sacred tree decorated with ropes. Later, the boy stands at a traditional stone purification fountain, washing his hands with running water from a bamboo pipe. (5) The final segment takes place in an indoor Japanese restaurant at night. The boy is at the dining table, sticking his tongue out and looking at his reflection in a shiny spoon. A woman's face is partially visible as she interacts with him. The video ends with a pink screen featuring a cartoon character logo.
